test.create_query: CREATE TABLE constant_sort_key_one (payload UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY identity(1)
CREATE TABLE constant_sort_key_four (payload UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (identity(1), identity(2), identity(3), identity(4))
CREATE TABLE nonconstant_sort_key_one (payload UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY payload
CREATE TABLE nonconstant_sort_key_four (payload UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (identity(1), identity(2), identity(3), payload)
